critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/field_leadership.py _is_authed: PM branch is gated on `get_pm_user is not None` — defensive but brittle. Since server.py never passes it, the entire branch is dead. Either drop the optional gate (always validate when X-PM-Token is present) or assert at attach_routes that get_pm_user was provided.

/app/backend/routes/field_leadership.py: Supervisor Notes filter for non-admin uses `f['kind'] = {'$ne': 'supervisor_notes'}` only when no kind filter is supplied. If a non-admin PM/leadership user passes ?kind=supervisor_notes explicitly, the filter is overwritten and they may see Supervisor Notes records (admin-only data leak). Add an explicit guard: if auth['role'] != 'admin' and kind == 'supervisor_notes', raise 403.

list_records counts_by_kind aggregation reuses `f` after possibly setting `kind` filter — counts will be skewed when a kind filter is active (other kinds always 0). Consider running counts on the unfiltered scope filter so the dashboard tile row always reflects totals across kinds.

rca of the issue: PM scoping broken: routes/field_leadership.py:attach_routes(...) declares `get_pm_user=None` as an optional kwarg. Inside _is_authed, the X-PM-Token branch only fires if `get_pm_user is not None`. server.py:6438 calls _attach_field_leadership_routes(app, db, require_admin, _field_leadership_send_email, _render_field_leadership_pdf, compute_pm_scope=_field_leadership_compute_pm_scope) — note get_pm_user is NOT passed. Result: every X-PM-Token request falls through to the leadership-token check, which fails, and the user gets 401. Reproduction: `curl -H "X-PM-Token: <pm_token>" {BASE}/api/field-leadership/check` → 401 'Field Leadership access required'. Mitigation: add `get_pm_user=<the same FastAPI dep used by other PM endpoints, likely `pm_auth.get_pm_user_optional` or inline `_pm_token_valid`>` to the attach_routes call. Alternatively, since _pm_token_valid is already defined inside attach_routes, simply drop the `get_pm_user is not None` guard so PM tokens are validated unconditionally.
